# add_pocket_types_to_rag { #mofography.compute.add_pocket_types_to_rag }

```python
compute.add_pocket_types_to_rag(
    rag,
    rep_to_type,
    pbc_groups=None,
    *,
    cluster_key=CLUSTER_ENV_PBC,
    as_string=True,
)
```

Stamp pocket-type labels on RAG nodes (parallel to ``cluster_geom_pbc``).

After :func:`~mofography.workflow.assign_pocket_types` with ``env_cluster``,
use ``cluster_key="cluster_env_pbc"`` with :func:`clustering_grid_from_regions`
and :func:`~mofography.visualize.plot_pocket_psds_on_rag`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                          | Default           |
|-------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| rag         |        | Region adjacency graph (NetworkX).                                                                   | _required_        |
| rep_to_type |        | ``{pbc_rep_region_id: type_id}`` (0-based), e.g. ``typed.rep_to_type``.                              | _required_        |
| pbc_groups  |        | PBC fragment groups; when given, every periodic copy of a pocket receives the representative's type. | `None`            |
| cluster_key | str    | Node attribute name (default ``cluster_env_pbc``).                                                   | `CLUSTER_ENV_PBC` |
| as_string   | bool   | Store labels as strings like ``cluster_geom_pbc``.                                                   | `True`            |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                    |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | Deep-copied RAG with ``cluster_key`` on nodes. |
